description: This file defines an Angular service class 'AssetProfilesTableConfigResolver' that configures and manages the asset profiles table, including columns, actions, and CRUD operations for AssetProfile entities.

classes.name: AssetProfilesTableConfigResolver
classes.description: An Angular service that provides configuration for the asset profiles table, including columns, actions, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for AssetProfile entities.

methods.name: configureAddActions
methods.description: Configures and returns the list of add action buttons for creating or importing asset profiles.

methods.name: setDefaultAssetProfile
methods.description: Sets a given asset profile as default after user confirmation.

methods.name: openAssetProfile
methods.description: Navigates to the detailed view of a specific asset profile.

methods.name: importAssetProfile
methods.description: Triggers import of an asset profile and refreshes the table data upon success.

methods.name: onAssetProfileAction
methods.description: Handles actions triggered on asset profile entries such as open, setDefault, and export.
